about: Fortnite heals and shields (creator's rules, 2026-10-11). Hold right mouse for useTicks. anim: drink = Minecraft's drinking animation and sound (shields, Chug Jug); eat = eating animation and sound (Bandages, Med Kit). Exactly 1 is removed from the stack per finished use. cap: the most this item brings that bar to (bandages stop at 75 HP as in Fortnite). kind heal never touches shield; shield never touches health; both = health first, then shield. maxUses > 0: at most this many can be used until the shield drops to reuseShield or below again (Mini Shield: 2 until the shield breaks at 0; Slurp Juice: 1 until the shield is 25 or less). stepAmount/stepTicks > 0 (Chug Jug): while right mouse is held it gives stepAmount every stepTicks, health until full and only then shield; amount is the jug's total points (200); points not used stay in the jug for next time and the jug disappears only when empty. overTimeTicks > 0 (Slurp Juice): after drinking, every overTimeTicks gives +1 health (until amount given or full) and +1 shield (until amount given or cap), so a Slurp always gives up to 75 shield on top of up to 75 health. Can't use one that would do nothing.
